lead.event: MAS appoints five managers and allocates S$1.45 billion under EQDP
lead.headline: MAS appoints five managers and allocates S$1.45 billion under EQDP
lead.blurb: Announced on 29 September, the third batch comprises Amundi, Franklin Templeton, HSBC Asset Management, M&G Investments and Natixis Investment Managers. The appointments bring allocations under the S$6.5 billion Equity Market Development Programme to S$5.4 billion across 14 managers, after S$3.95 billion went to the first two batches. A fourth batch is under review and is expected to be completed and announced in 2027.

macro_flows.event: Singapore CBD Grade A office rents rise in 3Q2026
macro_flows.headline: Singapore CBD Grade A office rents rise 1% in 3Q2026
macro_flows.blurb: CBD vacancy fell to 5.9%, its lowest in 10 quarters, as AI and tech firms drove demand. Databricks will open a 32,000 sq ft regional headquarters at IOI Central Boulevard Towers, while OpenAI is reportedly in advanced negotiations for about 120,000 sq ft at Shaw Tower. JLL maintained its 4% full-year CBD Grade A rental growth forecast.

deals_control.event: Canberra Drive EC tender sets record land price
deals_control.headline: Canberra Drive EC tender sets record land price at S$825 psf ppr
deals_control.blurb: A consortium of Santarli Realty, Heeton Holdings, Kay Lim Holdings and Sunray Group Holdings topped the tender with a S$163.9 million bid. The site drew 13 bids, the strongest turnout for an EC land tender since 2018. The upcoming Admiralty Walk EC tender on 17 December will offer another indication of land values under the new measures.

deals_control.event: GIC acquires 16 Four Points Flex hotels in Japan from KKR
deals_control.headline: GIC acquires 16 Four Points Flex hotels in Japan for about ¥125 billion
deals_control.blurb: The Marriott International-operated hotels span 11 cities, including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto and Fukuoka, and were sold by KKR. KKR announced the sale on 25 September without naming GIC or disclosing the price.

deals_control.event: DFI Retail takes control of Starbucks operations and exits Maxim's joint venture
deals_control.headline: DFI Retail Group takes over Starbucks operations and exits Maxim's JV for US$340 million
deals_control.blurb: Hongkong Caterers will pay about US$340 million in cash for DFI's 50% stake in Maxim's Caterers, becoming its sole owner. The Starbucks licensed operations span seven Asian markets, and the transaction is expected to complete by the end of March 2027.

deals_control.event: SERT proposes internalising its management and operating platform
deals_control.headline: SERT plans manager and platform internalisation, expects 5.9% FY2025 uplift
deals_control.blurb: SERT expects the move to lift pro forma FY2025 distribution per security by 5.9%. The proposed acquisition is priced 14.4% below the midpoint of an independent valuation’s indicative enterprise value range, while SWI Group plans to subscribe for 40 million new securities at €2.00 each, about 33% above SERT’s volume-weighted average trading price as of 24 September.

market_structure_policy.event: PTC approves 7% public transport fare adjustment
market_structure_policy.headline: PTC approves 7% public transport fare adjustment
market_structure_policy.blurb: Adult card fares rise by 12 to 13 cents per journey from 26 December, while concession fares increase by 5 cents and Workfare concession fares stay unchanged. SBS Transit Rail and SMRT Trains must contribute S$23.94 million, or 30% of expected fare revenue gains, to the Public Transport Fund.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: UMS Integration plans RM450 million share placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UMS Integration plans RM450 million share placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: It plans to issue 52.94 million new shares at RM8.50 each, expanding its share base by 5.63% if fully taken up. CGS International Securities Malaysia and AmInvestment Bank will jointly manage the placement, which will not be offered in Singapore. Around three-quarters of the proceeds will fund growth in Penang, with the remainder for Vietnam and Singapore.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Metasurface Technologies lodges preliminary document for SGX Catalist listing
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Metasurface lodges preliminary Catalist document with S$46.3 million order book
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Metasurface, already listed on Hong Kong’s GEM, has yet to determine the placement size or price. Based on recent Hong Kong trading, an indicative SGX placement price of S$0.53–S$0.56 has been suggested, implying a pre-placement market capitalisation of about S$81.7 million at S$0.55. UOB Kay Hian is sponsor, issue manager and placement agent.

earnings_guidance.event: SGX reports FY2026 results, dividends and executive remuneration
earnings_guidance.headline: SGX reports FY2026 results, dividends and CEO remuneration of S$8.37 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: His S$3.54 million cash bonus and S$3.54 million in long-term incentives made up nearly 85% of his pay. SGX proposed an extra S$0.125 per-share dividend, taking FY2026 dividends to S$0.57 per share, up 52%. Debt repayment is planned for FY2027.

earnings_guidance.event: CDL unveils FY2027–FY2029 investment and divestment strategy
earnings_guidance.headline: CDL unveils strategy for S$5 billion investment and at least S$6 billion divestments
earnings_guidance.blurb: The three-year plan also expects more than S$6 billion in property-development cash inflows and targets more than S$1 billion in PATMI from divestment gains. It directs 60% of investment to Singapore, 30% to China and Japan, and 10% to other markets. CDL plans a 145-unit luxury development in Shanghai’s Xintiandi in December.

earnings_guidance.event: Citi initiates UMS Integration coverage with Buy rating
earnings_guidance.headline: Citi initiates UMS Integration coverage with Buy rating and S$3.43 target
earnings_guidance.blurb: Analyst Arthur Pineda forecasts net profit to rise from S$42 million in FY2025 to S$136 million in FY2028, with revenue reaching S$577 million that year, 24% above DBS’s and 44% above UOB Kay Hian’s estimates. Citi values the company at 22 times FY2028 earnings blended with a discounted cash-flow valuation. All three brokerages expect FY2026 to be strong, with target prices ranging from S$3.27 to S$3.62 against UMS Integration’s last close of S$2.63.

earnings_guidance.event: New World Development reports record loss after ending 11 Skies agreement
earnings_guidance.headline: New World Development reports record HK$28.1 billion loss after ending 11 Skies deal
earnings_guidance.blurb: The loss included an HK$18.3 billion writedown after it ended its management agreement with Hong Kong Airport Authority. New World will pay HK$3 billion and hand over three office towers and an entertainment venue in April, removing a lease obligation UBS estimates at HK$1.8 billion or more a year from 2028 to 2066.
